text:
deploy-bot: Preflight completed for release v2.8.1. prompt-eval-suite: 1 regression detected (summarizer_prompts, metric drop ~3.4%). Auto-promotion blocked. Details: https://ci.redwood/inference/evals/2039123456 :warning:

sara: @mike saw this on the dashboard, is this noisy or a real delta? :eyes:

mike: it's consistent across 3 runs. avg rouge-like F1 down 3.4% compared to v2.7.4 on summarizer_prompts. CI noise threshold is 1.5%, so it's real.

priya: can we do a staggered rollout instead of full hold? maybe 10% canary while we triage?

mike: 10% canary still shows the drop in preliminary samples. suggests model change affects certain prompt clusters. I'd prefer holdback on user-facing route.

ana: (typo: ana) we should pin the runtime/model for the route until root cause identified. we can still ship other non-summarizer changes.

sara: agree. proposal: holdback summarizer route, pin to redwood/summarizer:v2.7.4 in prod, keep canary at v2.8.1 in staging only. notify CS and product.

sara: command to pin: ```/deploy pin route summarizer --model redwood/summarizer:v2.7.4 --reason "preflight eval regression"```

deploy-bot: Executing pin... pinned route "summarizer" -> redwood/summarizer:v2.7.4 in prod. Canary at v2.8.1 remains in staging. Change recorded: #CR-4598. :white_check_mark:

priya: thanks. can we also add a temporary traffic rule: canary 0% -> 10% internal-only for stress validation?

mike: set internal-only to 10%, external 0%. will run targeted evals on the failing prompt clusters tonight.

ana: I'll update release notes: add a line under "Known issues / holdbacks": "Summarizer model held back in prod due to prompt-eval regression; canary limited to 10% internal traffic. Investigating."

priya: also add change window notice for ops: "Holdback placed 2039-12-09 16:30 UTC; will re-evaluate after bisect and re-run evals."

sara: owner for triage = @mike. expected next step: bisect model changes vs tokenization/quantization. if regression reproduced on cpu run, escalate to infra/compilers.

mike: starting bisect now. I'll post a short triage doc and link when available. ETA 4 hours.

deploy-bot: Noted. Release pipeline paused for v2.8.1 user-facing summarizer route. Other routes continue. :information_source:

ana: thanks team. @support please prepare a canned line for customers: "We've detected a quality regression in the summarizer and have temporarily held back the new model for production while we investigate. No action needed from customers."

priya: +1. we'll sync to roadmap later if rollout changes. :thumbsup:
